caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with a floral pattern. The background of the fabric is a rich brown color. Over this background, there are large, prominent flowers in shades of beige and cream, with some flowers rendered in a blue tone. The flowers have multiple petals, and their centers and edges are outlined subtly to provide definition. Interspersed among the large flowers are smaller buds, also in shades of beige and blue. The flowers are connected by curving, flowing vines in a lighter brown or tan, some of which loop and curl across the fabric. There are also leaves associated with the flowers, predominantly beige with blue accents and internal vein-like markings. The composition is evenly distributed, with the floral and vine motifs repeating and spreading across the whole brown surface of the fabric piece. The edges of the fabric in the drawing are slightly frayed, and the image is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
